title: Advanced lost civilization and ancient Egypt

tellings.quote: I'm in the Randall Carlson Graham Hancock school. I don't think this is our first goound. I think ancient Egypt is a great testament to that.

plain: An advanced civilization rose and was lost before ours, and ancient Egypt is evidence that this is not humanity's first time around. Joe Rogan, a comedian and well-known podcast host, says this to Michels, placing himself in the school of the researcher Randall Carlson and the writer Graham Hancock, who argue for such a lost civilization.
